extracted.intended_audience: researchers and academics who want to be considered as peer reviewers for Springer Nature journals
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for researchers to register interest and be considered as peer reviewers for Springer Nature journals, including what information to provide and how selection/matching works. Focused on the recruitment process rather than review conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register interest via Reviewer Information webform
rubrics_metrics.description: You can register your interest in becoming a peer reviewer at Springer Nature via our Reviewer Information webform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the webform to express interest; the form asks for details about yourself and your area of expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide details about yourself and your area of expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: The webform asks you to provide details about yourself and your area of expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply accurate information about your research areas and qualifications so editorial teams can assess fit; no examples or field-format guidance provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment of interests and qualifications with journal recruitment needs
rubrics_metrics.description: If your interests and qualifications align with a journal for which we are currently recruiting reviewers, then the journal will be in touch to provide further details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being contacted depends on subject-matter alignment and the journal's current need for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matching based on expertise and availability; contact timing not guaranteed
rubrics_metrics.description: The nature of the peer-review process involves matching reviewers with manuscripts that align with their expertise and availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Springer Nature will review your information but might not necessarily reach out immediately; timing depends on matches between manuscript needs and reviewer availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retention of reviewer details in Springer Nature database
rubrics_metrics.description: Your details will be kept in our database of potential reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if not contacted immediately, your information is retained and editorial teams may contact you if an appropriate opportunity arises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existing Springer Nature reviewers should consult review guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: If you already are a Springer Nature peer-reviewer and you want to learn more about the process, please check out How to peer review at Springer Nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the linked guidance for information about the peer-review process and expectations for those already acting as reviewers.
